description: Step-level agent action registry. Extends skills/*/schema.json with fine-grained actions for closed-loop training. Actions marked planned_endpoint are simulated in L1 and mapped onto existing ROS2 contracts by gazebo_adapter.

perception.verify_operator.effect: Authorizes the requesting operator via face match. Must succeed before any motion or manipulation.

perception.request_tool_detection.effect: Actively re-perceives the scene and returns the latest detection (confidence, station) for tool_id.

navigation.navigate_to_station.effect: Moves the base to a named station from stations.yaml.

navigation.reposition.effect: Small base adjustment to change the camera viewpoint; primary recovery for occlusion / low confidence.

manipulation.select_grasp_pose.effect: Plans grasp candidates for the detected tool; returns grasp_id. Requires a fresh detection with confidence >= 0.70.

manipulation.pick_tool.effect: Executes the selected grasp. Requires a valid grasp_id from select_grasp_pose.

manipulation.verify_grasp.effect: Confirms the tool is held in the gripper. Should be called after pick and after any transit anomaly.

manipulation.handover_tool.effect: Places the held tool in the handover area for the operator. If the mission requires handover confirmation, hri.request_confirmation must succeed first.

manipulation.publish_arm_control.effect: Immediate arm-level control; system_stop halts all motion. Expected response to a user cancel or safety event.

hri.publish_tts.effect: Speaks to the operator; used to report anomalies, request presence, or announce state.

hri.request_confirmation.effect: Asks the operator a yes/no question and returns confirmed=true/false.

system-state.query_state.effect: Returns mission state, active nodes, warnings and motion_enabled.

mission.terminate.effect: Ends the episode and reports the outcome. success requires the tool to be handed over; failure/cancelled must state the cause.
